cases.observation: A reading system does not preserve a color-only difference cue.
cases.requested_change: Keep additions distinguishable with a non-color style cue.

cases.observation: A reviewer finds repeated filler and supplies a preferred edit.
cases.requested_change: Compare against the original, preserve meaningful emphasis, and generalize only supported edits.

cases.observation: A reader prefers source-first comparison, shorter atlas links, and deeper navigation.
cases.requested_change: Apply to the requested revision and inspect the table of contents in the target reader.

cases.observation: Two sampled states are read as a complete procedure even though the middle actions are not shown.
cases.requested_change: Describe the sampled states and leave the transition open until a continuous source or replay supports it.

cases.observation: The image description says three tasks remain, but the image only shows a badge with the numeral 3.
cases.requested_change: Describe the visible numeral unless a source label establishes what it counts.
